categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies block rescan logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a silent wallet rescan failure where descriptor wallets miss incoming transactions and report incorrect balances. If a transaction paying to a key beyond the look-ahead pool precedes a pool-expanding transaction within the same block, rescan operations silently ignore the earlier transaction, directly violating recovery correctness and balance accuracy.
